name: marvin
description: The complete Marvin toolkit as one MCP server under a single /marvin: slash prefix — core dev tools (commit, debug, adr, changelog, readme, migration-plan, explain, docs-search, handoff), the pr-* pull-request lifecycle (pr-create, pr-review, pr-resolve, pr-merge), the task-* spec pipeline, sec-* security scanners, and a track-* task tracker. Ships two blocking commit and push guards that can block a shell command; both can be disabled via hooks.enabled in .marvin/config.json or MARVIN_HOOKS_DISABLED=1.
